scope: Independent read-only review of scan identifier projection ordering, downstream consumers, targeted tests, and provided quality report. No repository edits.
conclusion: No loss of unrelated primary identifiers or references found in the changed flow. Explicit primary_identifiers are loaded first; explicit referenced_identifiers and identifier_candidates are then retained; legacy cve/cnvd/cnnvd/ghsa/qvd/xve fallback adds a value only if it is absent from all three buckets. Thus a matching explicit candidate/reference prevents legacy identifier_role=primary from promoting that same ID, while unmatched legacy values retain prior primary/reference/candidate behavior. Full projection comparison against HEAD found one role-only difference: Fastjson QVD-2026-43021 was previously present in both candidate and reference arrays and is now reference-only; the value remains complete and searchable under reference-non-primary.

consumer_review.catalog_record: Projects primary_identifiers, identifier_candidates, and referenced_identifiers from the corresponding Record buckets.
consumer_review.CVE_navigation_and_duplicate_candidates: Use only Record.primary, so explicit candidate/reference entries stay out of the primary CVE index and primary-ID duplicate grouping.
consumer_review.search: Searches all three projected buckets and labels nonprimary matches candidate-non-primary or reference-non-primary.
consumer_review.identifier_role_unknown: Still emitted for unmatched legacy candidates; suppressed when that legacy value was explicitly classified by candidate/reference or is already primary. Full repository scan produced 215 such warnings; the supplied quality.json reports 0 errors, 0 fatals, and 0 new debt.

edge_cases_checked: Legacy cve value repeats identifier_candidates with legacy identifier_role=primary: candidate retained; no primary promotion.
Legacy cve value repeats referenced_identifiers with legacy identifier_role=primary: reference retained; no primary promotion.
Legacy unknown-role cve value repeats identifier_candidates: candidate retained and redundant legacy-role warning suppressed.
Distinct legacy values continue through the previous primary/reference/candidate fallback according to identifier_role and primary_identifiers presence.
No downstream consumer was found that reconstructs primary IDs from legacy fields after scan.

Full repository HEAD/worktree generated-source comparison: only Fastjson QVD-2026-43021 changed projection, from candidate+reference to reference-only; it remains searchable and is correctly excluded from candidate classification by its explicit reference role.
limitation: Two simultaneously populated explicit nonprimary buckets can still contain the same identifier, and an explicit primary can coexist with an explicitly declared candidate/reference for the same value. This behavior predates the targeted legacy fallback adjustment and is not caused by the new ordering; it is a separate metadata-conflict policy question, not a newly observed data-loss path.
